== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Madra is the fundamental raw power of the spirit and serves as the essential material from which souls are constructed. It is physically centered in a core located just below the navel, where all lines of power connect. This energy can be cycled through the body in loops to provide strength and vitality, though exhausting one's supply of madra can leave a person feeling physically weak and empty. Madra is categorized by its various aspects, which are forms it takes to imitate natural elements or concepts such as fire, earth, wind, water, force, blood, life, dreams, and even space. While [[pure madra]] is compatible with all things and is highly effective at attacking or defending the spirit, it lacks the ability to interact with the physical world and can weaken specialized powers if used in excess. Most practitioners must harvest specific aspects from the world or use treasures and [[elixirs]] to strengthen their spirits. This energy is used to power constructs—objects or entities like puppets, clouds, or weapons that are [[Forged]] from madra—and to activate [[scripts]]. It also manifests as [[Remnants]], which are living forces left behind by powerful deceased artists. Through the use of madra, individuals can bend or break physical laws within certain limits.}}
